name: Boon Island & Chuck's Waterfall Duel
summary: Step ashore at Boon Island (Two Island), a peaceful tropical settlement featuring a bustling market, the Joyful Game Corner, and a Move Relearner house. Visit the secluded cabin where an elderly lady trades rare treasures for collected Heart Scales: claim the Dream Mirror for 10 Heart Scales and a Lucky Egg for 25. Activate the Poké Radar in the western grasslands to locate elusive wild Ninjask. Trek north into the mountain gorge where Cianwood Gym Leader Chuck trains under a thundering waterfall. Challenge Chuck to a 5 vs 5 duel to claim the Storm Badge, the Eyebrows & Stache vanity hat, and the Navel Ticket unlocking the ferry to Navel Rock.
